overview: Medford Bytes host Danielle Balocca interviewed newly elected City Councilor Kit Collins regarding her campaign experience, local priorities, and goals for her first term.

items.title: Podcast Intro and Announcements
items.summary: Danielle Balocca announces podcast stickers available in Medford and introduces City Councilor Kit Collins.

items.title: Favorite Local Restaurant
items.summary: Kit Collins shares that Colette Bakery in South Medford is her favorite local place to eat.

items.title: Motivation to Run for City Council
items.summary: Kit Collins explains how joining Our Revolution Medford in 2020 led to her decision to run for City Council to focus on housing stability and climate policy.

items.title: Campaign Experience and Systemic Barriers
items.summary: Kit Collins reflects on the social demands of running for office and discusses systemic barriers that make campaigning difficult without specific privileges.

items.title: Our Revolution Medford Endorsement and Campaign Structure
items.summary: Kit Collins details the endorsement process for Our Revolution Medford and discusses candidate diversity and grassroots campaign strategy.

items.title: First-Term Priorities
items.summary: Kit Collins outlines key goals for her first term, including advancing the housing production plan, updating the city website, and tracking progress toward carbon net-neutrality.

items.title: Constituent Outreach and Closing
items.summary: Kit Collins encourages residents interested in running for local office to reach out to her and discusses plans for regular constituent engagement.
